verdict: Yes. Invogue pitched women's shapewear on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal. This is a technical product with a loyal customer base once the fit is right. Compete on comfort and inclusive sizing rather than price.
angle: Indian women increasingly buy shapewear for sarees, lehengas and western wear. Most options are either cheap and uncomfortable or expensive imports. A comfortable, breathable product designed for Indian weather and outfits fills a real gap.
